units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:4">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 4</cite> <he>קוֹנֵחַ מן האגן</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>קודח מן האגד</he>, corr. acc.) he may wipe off (the wine or oil which is left after measuring) on the rim of the measure.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 8:3">Ber. VIII, 3</cite> <he>מְקַנֵּחַ ידיו וכ׳</he> a person may wipe his hands with the napkin and let it lie on the table.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 21:3">Sabb. XXI, 3</cite> <he>מְקַנְּחִין בו</he> you may wipe the table with it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 81b:2">Ib. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>לקַנֵּחַ וכ׳</he> to wipe off (the posteriors) with &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:10">B. Bath. V, 10</cite> <he>הסיטון מקנח וכ׳</he> the wholesaler must cleanse (by rubbing) his measures once in thirty days; a. fr.
<cite ref="Chullin 36a">Ḥull. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>בנ׳ הדם וכ׳</he> when the blood was wiped off between the cutting of one organ (<cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימָן</he></cite>) and the other.
